LESSON: SIGNIFICANCE OF TAWHID

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.1: Significance of Tawhid

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Significance of Tawhid
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why do Muslims believe in Tawhid?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Significance of Tawhid.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do Muslims believe in Tawhid?
2. How is Tawhid manifested in a Muslim?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
